name: Path of Duality grants attack power from the higher of Strength and Agility and +75% spell power (#7029)
contract: Path of Duality 129243: 'Granting you Attack Power equal to your Strength or Agility whichever is higher and
increases your Spell Power from items and effects by 75%.' Spell.dbc carries the helpers 820056 'Path of
Duality: Strength -> AP' (100% Strength to attack power) and 820057 'Path of Duality: Agility -> AP' (100%
Agility to melee and ranged attack power), 20 s each, driven by 129243's 15 s periodic dummy. Nothing applied
them, so the pretest saw +30 attack power instead of at least 100.
A level-60 human Hero has 105 Strength and 65 Agility (player_class_stats), so the Strength helper applies.
Ring 19147 gives 33 spell power, which Path of Intelligence turns into 66 (wildcard-path-of-intelligence-6690).
Expected: taking the path applies 820056 (not 820057) and adds at least 100 attack power; the ring then adds
57-58 spell power; leaving the path removes the helper and both bonuses.
Not asserted (no rate in any source): Intellect to melee/ranged crit and Agility to spell crit.
'Spell casts no longer reset your next auto attack': without the path a Shadow Bolt resets the idle swing timer (attack_timer_ms > 0 after the cast); with the path the timer stays at 0.
The ring is equipped at the start: equipment changes are refused in combat, and the Shadow Bolt checks start combat.

steps.label: Take Path of Duality (spell power check, out of combat)

DISCRIMINATING: the ring's 33 spell power counts 75% more
Leave the path for the swing-timer control

Leaving the path drops the spell power bonus
SETUP: the swing timer is idle
CONTROL: Shadow Bolt without the path
SETUP: Shadow Bolt lands
CONTROL: without the path the cast reset the swing timer
Let the swing timer run out
SETUP: the swing timer is idle again
Take Path of Duality
SETUP: the path's stat buff is active
DISCRIMINATING: the Strength helper applies (Strength 105 > Agility 65)
The Agility helper does not
DISCRIMINATING: attack power rises by the higher stat (Strength 105)
Shadow Bolt with the path
SETUP: the second Shadow Bolt lands
DISCRIMINATING: with the path the cast does not reset the swing timer
Past the 20 s helper duration: the 15 s tick keeps it up
The helper is still active after its own duration
SETUP: the stat buff leaves with the path
The attack power helper leaves with the path
Leaving the path drops the attack power
